schedule.lang2Note: Period 5 is only for students who chose a second foreign language or Classical Chinese.
schedule.inqNote: Checked against 2027 official guidance for standard candidates. Return to your room by 14:40 for period 4.

inq.swap: History papers collected · elective papers handed out
inq.inq2: Second inquiry slot (one- or two-subject candidates)
inq.collect: Collection of the completed question paper

schedule.generalNote: Candidates receiving exam accommodations must check their separate timetable. This screen does not replace exam announcements or proctor instructions.
inqRules: Korean History is compulsory. Missing it invalidates the CSAT result and no score report is issued.
Take inquiry subjects in your registered order, with only the current subject's question paper on your desk.
Writing or changing answers for the completed first subject during the second inquiry slot is misconduct.
schedule.inqSingle: One-subject candidates wait during the first slot and take their subject from 16:07 to 16:37. Studying during the waiting period is prohibited; follow proctor instructions.

checklist.title: Packing checklist
checklist.verifyNote: Checked against 2027 official guidance on {date}. Check the official notice and proctor instructions for accepted IDs and special items.

items.idCard: Accepted photo ID (mobile IDs not accepted)
items.watch: Analog watch (hour/minute (second) hands only, no communication, payment or electronic display)
items.water: Drinking water (container without an electronic display)
items.tissue: Tissues and needed medicine (special items require approval)
items.signPen: Black computer marking pen (personal supply allowed)

checklist.provided: A black computer marking pen and mechanical pencil are supplied. Ask a proctor for white correction tape when needed.
checklist.penNote: Personal black marking pens and white correction tape are allowed; personal mechanical pencils cannot be carried during the test. Use the black marking pen for answers and the handwriting verification phrase.
banned: Communication/payment devices, including phones, smartwatches, smart glasses, tablets, and Bluetooth earphones
Items with LCD/LED displays, including electronic dictionaries, digital watches, and electronic-display tumblers
Rechargeable devices such as e-cigarettes and power banks, and all other electronic devices
checklist.bannedNote: If you brought one, hand it to a proctor during collection before period 1. Keeping an unsubmitted device is misconduct even when it is powered off.
tips: For a lost ticket, bring a photo matching your application and your ID to exam headquarters by 08:00 for reissue.
Lunch and drinking water are not supplied. Check your test location and travel time in advance.
Personal mechanical pencils, ballpoint pens, and notebooks cannot be carried during the test. Follow prior approval procedures for medical devices, earplugs, cushions, or other special items.

sheet.title: Answer sheet
sheet.desc: Use this for advance practice or recording answers after the exam. Answers and subject choices are saved in this browser; printing outputs only the record sheet.
sheet.clearConfirm: Clear all answers and elective names?
sheet.warn: The Ministry says to complete the answer memo on the back of the official ticket before each ending signal. Writing after the signal and before papers are collected is misconduct. This site's printout is for advance practice or post-exam records; follow official guidance and proctor instructions at the exam.
sheet.countNote: Question counts were checked against the 2027 implementation plan. * marks short-answer questions.
sheet.printScope: For advance practice or post-exam records. This printout does not authorize its use during the exam.

timeline.title: After the CSAT
timeline.desc: Key 2027 admissions dates, from score release to additional recruitment.

items.jeongsiApply: Regular admission applications (3+ days per university)

timeline.note: Based on the 2027 admissions plan. Regular applications run for at least three university-selected days within Jan 4–7. Early additional offers end Dec 29 at 18:00, registration Dec 30 at 22:00; regular additional offers end Feb 17 at 18:00, registration Feb 18 at 22:00. Check each university's latest prospectus.

whatIs.title: The 2027 CSAT at a glance
whatIs.desc: The 2027 CSAT takes place on November 19, 2026, with scores reported on December 11. This tool helps with supplies, the standard timetable, advance timing practice, and post-exam answer records. Official guidance and proctor instructions take priority at the test center.

dayBefore.title: The day before
items: Check the announced location and time for the November 18 preliminary gathering. Verify your registered subjects, test location, and travel time.
Prepare your ticket and accepted photo ID. Mobile IDs are not accepted.
Check that your watch has no communication, payment, or electronic-display functions.
Pack lunch and drinking water, and maintain your usual routine.

examDay.title: On exam day
items: Be in your assigned room by 08:10, including if you are not taking Korean.
If you brought electronics, submit them to a proctor before period 1.
Take compulsory Korean History and follow your registered inquiry subject order.
Stop writing at the ending signal and follow instructions for collecting papers and leaving.

tips.title: Making the most of the time left
items: Open a subject timer for advance practice. It does not replace listening audio or exam announcements.
Full timetable practice shifts the displayed times so the moment you start becomes the Korean start time.
The supplies checklist is saved in this browser; revisit it the night before.
After the exam, enter your recorded answers and treat estimated grades as estimates, not official scores.

items.a: November 19, 2026. Every candidate must be in their assigned room by 08:10. Scores are reported on December 11.

Black computer marking pens, white correction tape, black pencils, erasers, and 0.5 mm black pencil leads are allowed. Personal mechanical pencils cannot be carried during the test. Marking pens and mechanical pencils are supplied; correction tape can be requested.

items.q: What if I brought my phone?
items.a: Submit it to a proctor during collection before period 1. Keeping it without submission is misconduct even when switched off.
Bring a photo matching your application and your ID to exam headquarters by 08:00 for reissue. Contact headquarters promptly if you cannot prepare them.

items.q: May I use this answer sheet at the test center?
items.a: This printout is for advance practice or post-exam records, and is separate from the official ticket's answer memo. Writing after the ending signal before paper collection is misconduct. Follow the official notice and proctor instructions for use during the test or breaks.

practice.title: Practice with a subject timer
practice.description: Open the timer with the subject's duration filled in. You must press Start yourself; it does not start automatically.
practice.limit: For advance practice using standard-candidate durations. English's 70 minutes includes listening, but this timer supplies no listening audio, exam broadcasts, or supervision. Do not use a device during the actual exam.
